feeds.title: EuGMS Blog
feeds.description: ECGI - is a Group of the EuGMS European Geriatric Medicine Society. We aim to help and support networking amongst younger geriatricians and create suitable opportunities. We ensure that the Boards of EuGMS hear the voice, concerns, and aspirations of younger colleagues.

feeds.title: GMC Solutions | Senior Transitions Blog
feeds.description: Our blog will teach you more about geriatric or elder care options and how we approach helping families. Senior Transitions' Geriatric/Aging Care Managers provide services for all aspects of the challenges that aging community members and their families face. We help the family understand the options available in the community and work with them to get services in place that honor the quality care families need and want.

feeds.title: News Medical » Geriatrics News
feeds.description: Get the latest geriatrics news, research, COVID-19, and more. News Medical is a tight-knit community of scientific, medical, and life sciences experts that produce and share the latest information, in a readable, understandable way. They are committed to curating a constantly-expanding index of free content including recent innovations in healthcare, research, and technology.

feeds.title: Geriatric Mum
feeds.description: Welcome to Geriatric Mum Blog: The place to be if you are a mum who happens to be older. I am Lucy Baker and here I share some of my experiences, real-life interviews, and much more.

feeds.title: Better Health While Aging
feeds.description: Dr. Leslie Kernisan shares practical information to help you address problems that often keep aging adults from enjoying better health, well-being, and independence. BetterHealthWhileAging.net is a mission-driven health and caregiving information site that provides practical, actionable information for older adults and family caregivers.

feeds.title: Medical Xpress » Gerontology and Geriatrics News
feeds.description: Read the latest news on gerontology and geriatrics Research. Medical Xpress is a web-based medical and health news service that is part of the renowned Science X network. Science X is a network of high-quality websites that provides the most complete and comprehensive daily coverage of science, technology, and medical news.

feeds.title: GeriAcademy | Geri Blog
feeds.description: Geri blog's goal is to provide education that is easy to understand on aging-related topics including disease processes. Welcome to GeriAcademy, a free informational resource created by geriatrician Dr. Golnosh Sharafsaleh. GeriAcademy takes a holistic approach to providing education and general information on aging and aging diseases.

feeds.title: Genson Geriatrics Blog
feeds.description: At Genson Geriatrics Management, we oversee the care of a loved one while providing the family with detailed feedback. We're here to help you navigate your loved one's elder care management through these challenging times. Genson posts written and video blogs about geriatrics, problems the elderly face with technology, health issues, and more.

feeds.title: The Geriatric Dietitian Blog
feeds.description: In-depth blog articles on nutrition for older adults. These geriatric nutrition resources help caregivers and families care for the elderly. Everyone deserves access to a geriatric dietitian. The Geriatric Dietitian offers evidence-based, easy-to-understand nutrition and general health information- all specific to the older adult.

feeds.title: The Medical Care Blog » Geriatrics
feeds.description: Read about Geriatrics, problems faced by the elderly, tests, and more in our archives. We are an academic, non-profit, volunteer-run blog sponsored by the peer-reviewed journal Medical Care and Medical Care Section of the American Public Health Association. We aim to disseminate ideas and contribute to discussions and controversies in the field.

feeds.title: Insights Therapeutic Blog
feeds.description: Geriatrics Toolbox is Insight Therapeutics' blog offering tools, resources, and insights into the care of older adults. Established in 1996, Insight Therapeutics, LLC, is a clinical research, professional medical education, patient care, and health communications organization. We strive to provide research and information services of unmatched value in the industry.

feeds.title: Dr Liz Geriatrics Blog
feeds.description: Dr. Liz is a Geriatrician and Dementia Expert who provides online education, individual video assessments, and support for caregivers. The mission of Dr. Liz Geriatrics is to take all of this experience and distill it into bite-sized, relevant education aimed at caregivers in all parts of the spectrum. Check out our blog to learn more about Eldercare and dementia!

feeds.title: Division of Geriatric Medicine News
feeds.description: Department of Medicine's goal is to leverage a new era of aging to improve care for older patients, who are rewriting medical history as they view new horizons in health and longevity. On this site, you will learn about our geriatrics clinical, research, and education programs.

feeds.title: Cathy Cress Blog » Geriatric Care Manager
feeds.description: The expert writes about the life and problems of a Geriatric Care Manager. Cathy Jo Cress MSW is an expert in Geriatric Care Management. She offers two online courses in geriatric care management, additionally, she has taught geriatric care management at the University of Florida.

feeds.title: MedPage Today » Geriatrics
feeds.description: Read about the latest news in Geriatrics. MedPage Today is a trusted source for clinical news coverage across medical specialties. We cover all the clinical news, findings, and announcements that we think will directly affect the lives and practices of healthcare professionals throughout the U.S.

feeds.title: Geriatric Academy Blog
feeds.description: Subscribe to Geriatric Academy's blog Ger-E-Digest and Get weekly informational articles on senior health topics and Over Medication in Older Adults. Geriatric Academy strives to uphold and enhance the dignity and quality of life of older adults by empowering them to take charge of their healthcare and medication therapy, through self-advocacy and learning.
